text:
tom: FYI Mariners Inc asked for a quick POC to validate switching from CompetitorY to Redwood. Scope: /generate, chat streaming, and embeddings. They want parity notes + pricing + security answers. Target demo in 8 business days. Can we call out blockers?
anya: Surface deltas we should expect: tokenization differences for emoji and smart quotes, default stop behavior, and the streaming envelope format. We'll build a tiny compat shim to map headers and chunk shapes.
diego: Pricing: Mariners currently does ~2M gen tokens + 500k embed tokens/mo. I'll produce three scenarios (monthly low/typical/peak) and show Hosted vs Dedicated costs and break-even.
sec-bot: Security task created: S-7721 assigned to anya. Need SOC2 artifacts, SSO metadata, and KMS diagram.
tom: Technical checklist for POC: 1) proxy that maps CompY headers -> Redwood 2) prompt-normalizer for stops/temperature 3) smoke tests: 100 prompts + 20 convo sessions + 1k embed vectors. Include deterministic seed set.
anya: Minimal proxy example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://poc.redwood/internal/proxy \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POC' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-1","input":"$PROMPT","max_tokens":128}'
```
diego: For response diffs we'll run deterministic runs with temperature=0 and capture token counts, exact-match on structured outputs, and cosine similarity on embeddings. Expect small token deltas around punctuation.
tom: Mariners asked about VPC/private flow and whether audit logs contain request-level metadata. Anya, can you confirm?
anya: Private deployment: yes, per-request audit logs with request_id, model_version, token counts. Hosted can provide per-request traces if they opt into extended retention. I'll prepare the language for the SOW.
diego: Ops note: I'll need the sample prompts and their expected monthly volume to run the synthetic. Also need their firewall IPs for allowlist.
sec-bot: POC env provisioned: redwood-poc-mariners-172999. Access TTL 21 days.
tom: Owners: Anya - security + SOW language. Diego - pricing + synthetic run. I'll own proxy/compat shim and demo coordination.
anya: I'll draft answers today and flag any HSM/KMS lead times (HSM adds ~2 weeks).
diego: I'll post the pricing table by Friday and attach the synthetic run logs.
tom: Pre-demo dry run 24h prior. If any blocker surfaces, call it out here by EOD Monday. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Reminder: POC logs retention defaults to 7 days; extendable on request.
